'''Adrian Seymour''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 2nd at [[March 2002 Modesto tournament]] on 30 March 2002 with Slave Quarters Choke, according to Clayton Atkin's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3546">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2002-04-01-modesto-ca-3-30-02-undead-strawberriesd3546/ modesto-ca-3-30-02-undead-strawberries], DeckTech (Clayton "TheDohMan" Atkin, 1 April 2002). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2002-04-01-modesto-ca-3-30-02-undead-strawberriesd3546/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
